description:
Exceptional 4 Bedroom Semi-Detached Family Home Presented in Turn-Key Condition

Peter Barry Estate Agents are delighted to present 5 Heathervue, Glanmire to the market. This impressive four-bedroom semi-detached residence offers bright, spacious accommodation throughout and is presented in excellent turn-key condition, making it an ideal choice for growing families seeking a quality home in a highly desirable location. 

Situated within a mature residential development, this attractive property enjoys a private rear garden with side access, off-street parking for two cars, and easy access to all local amenities. Crestfield Shopping Centre is just a short stroll away, while the Dunkettle Interchange provides excellent connectivity to Cork City, Little Island, and beyond.
A highly efficient B3 BER rating enhances comfort, reduces energy consumption, and may qualify buyers for competitive Green Mortgage lending options.  Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this wonderful home has to offer.
